name: variable and escaping
liquid: {{ variables.name }} {{ variables.name | raw }} {{ variables.name | raw }}

name: missing variable
liquid: [{{ variables.nope }}]

name: dot path
liquid: {{ variables.person.first_name }} {{ variables.person.address.city }}

name: section scopes names and hides outer
liquid: {% if variables.person and variables.person != empty and variables.person != 0 %}[{{ variables.person.first_name }}|{{ variables.person.company }}|{{ variables.company }}]{% endif %}

name: section on missing value

name: section on truthy values
liquid: {% if variables.t and variables.t != empty and variables.t != 0 %}t{% endif %}{% if variables.s and variables.s != empty and variables.s != 0 %}s{% endif %}{% if variables.w and variables.w != empty and variables.w != 0 %}w{% endif %}{% if variables.n and variables.n != empty and variables.n != 0 %}n{% endif %}{% if variables.sz and variables.sz != empty and variables.sz != 0 %}sz{% endif %}

name: section current value
liquid: {% if variables.position and variables.position != empty and variables.position != 0 %}Role: {{ variables.position }}{% endif %}

name: section on array renders once with no iteration
liquid: {% if variables.items and variables.items != empty and variables.items != 0 %}[{{ variables.items.name }}]{% endif %}

name: inverted section
liquid: {% unless variables.years and variables.years != empty and variables.years != 0 %}none{% endunless %}{% unless variables.name and variables.name != empty and variables.name != 0 %}nameless{% endunless %}{% unless variables.here and variables.here != empty and variables.here != 0 %}x{% endunless %}

name: inverted scope needs parent path
liquid: {% unless variables.name and variables.name != empty and variables.name != 0 %}[{{ variables.name.job_title }}][{{ variables.job_title }}]{% endunless %}

name: section then inverted is if else
liquid: {% if variables.vip and variables.vip != empty and variables.vip != 0 %}gold{% endif %}{% unless variables.vip and variables.vip != empty and variables.vip != 0 %}plain{% endunless %}|{% if variables.vip2 and variables.vip2 != empty and variables.vip2 != 0 %}gold{% endif %}{% unless variables.vip2 and variables.vip2 != empty and variables.vip2 != 0 %}plain{% endunless %}

liquid:
{% for item_1 in variables.items %}
  • {{ item_1.name }} x{{ item_1.qty }}

name: each over scalars
liquid: {% for item_1 in variables.tags %}<{{ item_1 }}>{% endfor %}

name: each parent paths
liquid: {% for item_1 in variables.items %}[{{ item_1.company }}||{{ variables.company }}|{{ variables.company }}]{% endfor %}

name: nested each with inner reaching outer item
liquid: {% for item_1 in variables.groups %}{{ item_1.name }}:{% for item_2 in item_1.members %}{{ item_2.name }}@{{ item_1.name }},{% endfor %};{% endfor %}

name: each inside section
liquid: {% if variables.order and variables.order != empty and variables.order != 0 %}{% for item_1 in variables.order.lines %}{{ item_1.sku }}/{{ variables.order.id }} {% endfor %}{% endif %}

name: each on missing and empty
liquid: a{% for item_1 in variables.x %}x{% endfor %}{% for item_2 in variables.y %}y{% endfor %}b

name: parent above root stays at root
liquid: {{ variables.top }}

unicode names and values

name: bool print
liquid: {{ variables.t }} {{ variables.f }}

name: object and array print blank
liquid: [{{ variables.o }}][{{ variables.a }}]

name: this prefix
liquid: {{ variables.this.name }}|{% for item_1 in variables.xs %}{{ item_1.this }}{% endfor %}

name: multiline tag
liquid: {{ variables.name }}

name: if and else from a migration guide
source: Postmark's Resend migration guide. Mustachio itself refuses this tag.
liquid: {% if variables.plan and variables.plan != empty and variables.plan != 0 %}On {{ variables.plan }}{% else %}No plan{% endif %}|{% if variables.nope and variables.nope != empty and variables.nope != 0 %}x{% else %}y{% endif %}
